title: GS21 leverage hump, gs_bv -1.0, bounded exposure, per-firm compensation (gs_qcomp 1), persistent y (kappa_y 0.1)
question: gvylqc10 with a more persistent y: does a y shock move equity values enough for the hump to clear the bar?
notes:
WHY (2026-11-05). With gs_qcomp 1 the room stops rising in the loading at about 10% (gvylqc10 10%, gvylqc15 10%, gvylqc20 7%), and gamma_v 4 did not help (gvylqc5g4). The equity y-slope is a fraction of the production exposure because y mean-reverts in about 3 years (kappa_y 0.35); kappa_y 0.1 makes a shock last about 10 years, so the same exposure moves the equity value about 3x as much. Otherwise gvylqc10.

PRECOMMITMENT STATUS: precommitted=false; ids filled from the Quest build log by the solve script before any seed runs.

PREDICTION (2026-11-05): room 30% or more and a fair gap at or above +0.029. FALSIFIED if room is at or below 10% on three seeds.

method.gs_capital_structure: gs_fixcs 2: firm-level coupon per unit capital drawn at birth uniformly from the grid nodes in [0.1, 0.9], fixed for life, no refinancing
